_readme: Curation defaults for the App Hub. Keyed by the portal-service registry id (stable forever — never a container id). Per-app keys: icon (emoji), icon_url (PNG/WebP), name, launch_url, pinned, hidden, description, aliases. Runtime hide/pin toggles live in the DB overlay (agent_memory widget_state 'portal:overrides') and take precedence over this file; overlay aliases are UNIONED with these. Apps listed here with no portal match become synthetic launch targets (status 'unknown'). To make a NEW service appear everywhere, add it to vault-service/projects.json — not here.
_aliases_readme: aliases = extra names YOU say for an app ('open the trading bot'). They are matched EXACTLY (normalized: case/spaces/dashes ignored), so they beat widget spawning — keep them app-specific. Do NOT add a bare widget word like 'music', 'notes' or 'map': that would steal 'play music'-style asks from their widgets. A '-service' backend is never opened by a vague ask; say its full name ('open trading service') to reach it.

music-player.name: Music Player
music-player._launch_url_why: OVERRIDE. The vault registry gives music-player domain 'music.braindeadbot.com', so portal's domain-beats-url convention hands out https://music.braindeadbot.com — which has NO DNS RECORD (verified 2026-08-16: getent finds nothing, curl exits 6, while :3232 answers 200). Every open of this app landed on a dead tab. Remove this override once the domain actually exists.

office-client._why: Access through trading-client directly; hidden from independent launcher / side panel per user instruction.

minio._why: Infra, but its API port redirects to the embedded HTML console, so the rail's text/html probe reads it as a client frontend. Force it off the rail.
